name: Pause screen (iPhone shield)
desc: Copy needs clinical/legal review. iPhone system shield (ShieldConfiguration extension). Apple allows only an icon (here the Tether app icon), a title, a subtitle and two buttons, so this screen uses nothing else. Colors and text come from the shared intercept tokens. Not an app route: reference for the native shield. Take a breath posts a local notification with two actions: Take my breath and Get support (opens Rescue without the small step). Needs device validation.

body.text: You asked to slow this one down. Video apps is on your list. 2 of 3 “open anyway” left today. Open Tether for support.

action.value: Notification: open Tether to take your breath, or get support

notes: A shield button cannot open Tether directly: it posts a local notification; tapping it opens Tether. If notifications are off, the subtitle tells the person to open Tether for support. Needs device validation. The notification has two actions: Take my breath (opens the small step) and Get support (opens Rescue directly, without the small step). Native requirement (iOS shield and app selection, Android overlay, picker and service): never shield or pause Tether, the phone dialer or emergency calling, even if they are selected or a session pauses "everything". Needs device validation.
Reference surface: drawn natively or by the system; excluded from release-check counts, checked by device screenshots.
